contract.entry: vec3 wall(vec2 p) returns the colour of the point p in OKLab (L, a, b).
contract.coords: p is in height units: y runs from -1 at the bottom to +1 at the top of the target, x from -aspect to +aspect. The same composition at any size; more pixels only add detail.

uniforms.name: u_res
uniforms.desc: the target size in device pixels

uniforms.name: u_dpr
uniforms.desc: device pixels per CSS pixel; micro texture (paper, weave, stars) is sized in CSS pixels

uniforms.name: u_pal
uniforms.desc: the colour pack in OKLab: the pack's dark and light palettes mixed on the CPU for the theme (and for a pack crossfade); with Dynamic on, shifted for the hour on the CPU

uniforms.name: u_dark
uniforms.desc: 0 light .. 1 dark, eased, for the few things that are not colour (stars, shadow strength); with Dynamic on it also follows the clock

uniforms.name: u_grain
uniforms.desc: 0..1 film grain, applied by main() to OKLab L (0 while the engine blurs for Focus: the blur pass adds the grain after it)

uniforms.name: u_tilt
uniforms.desc: Perspective: the picture displacement in height units (|u_tilt| <= 0.015, scaled by the wallpaper's depth and by the switch; zero when off or under Reduce Motion)

uniforms.name: u_tg
uniforms.desc: 1: main() shifts p by u_tilt; 0: the wallpaper layers itself (persp.own)

uniforms.name: u_light
uniforms.desc: the current direction toward the light; equals light.def when Dynamic is off or at the theme's home hour

uniforms.name: u_lw
uniforms.desc: the strength (0.028) of the brightness wash main() adds for u_light - u_light0; 0 when the wallpaper reads u_light itself (light.own)

uniforms.name: u_focus
uniforms.desc: 0..1 Focus, read only by wallpapers with focus.own; the others are blurred by the engine after the render

rules: Maths only: no textures, no derivatives, loops with constant bounds, arrays indexed by constants or loop indices, no bit operations, no preprocessor in the wallpaper source.

Render once at the window size (and again only when the size, theme, pack, option, clock or focus changes, or while the pointer moves the Perspective), then cache. Theme, pack, accent, clock, focus and switch changes ease or crossfade over 0.2 to 0.6 s.

Skia SkSL: declare the uniforms, keep head out, use lib and the wallpaper source as written, and port main() to half4 main(float2 coord) with coord.y flipped so y is up. Focus is SkImageFilters.Blur on the rendered picture (sigma = Focus * 0.022 * height in px) with the grain added after it.
Palettes are sRGB hex; convert to OKLab on the CPU (the page does it with the standard OKLab matrices).

dynamic.keyFields: l: lightness shift added to OKLab L; c: chroma multiplier; h: hue shift in degrees; light: [x, y] direction toward the light (optional)
dynamic.method: The look at a clock hour is interpolated between the two neighbouring keys with smoothstep (night 24h wraps to 0h). The palette is shifted by (look - home look) in OKLCH, where the home look is day for light mode and night for dark mode (blended by the eased dark amount), so the authored palette shows exactly at the home hour. u_dark follows the same way with night = 1, dawn = 0.45, dusk = 0.5, day = 0. u_light = light.def + (look.light - home.light). Out-of-gamut colours lose chroma, never hue or lightness.

accent.method: A sixth pack built at run time: the anchor role (the ramp role, 0..4, whose L is closest to the accent's, per theme) takes the accent hue; every other role takes the accent hue plus half of the hue offset (capped at 60 degrees) that pack 0 has from the anchor role; every role keeps its own L and chroma, the chroma scaled by accent chroma / 0.16 (clamped 0.3..1.15). Same resolvePack, same gamut mapping and warm-dark rules.

perspective.note: height units at depth 1 (about 6 px at 800 px high); off under Reduce Motion; on by default where persp.def is 1

focus.note: Gaussian sigma of Focus 1 as a share of the picture height; built in (two cheap passes) unless focus.own

tiers.name: Vibrant
tiers.desc: Rich and bold: saturated colour, strong light and deep shadow.

tiers.name: Balanced
tiers.desc: Colourful but restrained: real materials and soft light, moderate colour.

tiers.name: Minimal
tiers.desc: Calm and low in contrast: one quiet idea, soft colour, nothing that pulls the eye.

measured.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (0x00002704) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
measured.note: median of 11 single renders, each finished (readPixels), after 3 warm-up draws; measured twice and the slower kept

wallpapers.name: Riptide
wallpapers.desc: Seven waves of colour stacked from the horizon down, each crest catching the light and casting a soft shadow on the one behind.

wallpapers.name: Corolla
wallpapers.desc: A fan of long curved petals opening from the corner, each one cupped, lit along its edge and shading the petal beneath.

wallpapers.name: Prism
wallpapers.desc: A glowing orb seen through a pane of reeded glass: every flute flips and slices it into ribbons of colour.

wallpapers.name: Solstice
wallpapers.desc: The sun sitting low over five ridges of mountains, each farther one paler in the haze and lit along its crest.

wallpapers.name: Northlight
wallpapers.desc: Curtains of aurora over a still northern lake, the ridge and the light mirrored in the water, with stars after dark.

wallpapers.name: Satin
wallpapers.desc: Folds of iridescent satin: the colour shifts with the angle of every fold, with a soft sheen on the ridges.

wallpapers.name: Orbit
wallpapers.desc: Six spheres resting on a seamless studio sweep under a large soft key light, each with its contact shadow and the room in its rim.

wallpapers.name: Atoll
wallpapers.desc: A tropical lagoon from above: deep channels, turquoise shallows netted with caustic light, and a sandbar edged with foam.

wallpapers.name: Radiant
wallpapers.desc: Pleated rays fanning up from a glow below the frame, each fold lit on one face and shadowed on the other.

wallpapers.name: Spectrum
wallpapers.desc: A single beam of light breaking into a wide spectrum as it crosses a hazy, darkened room.

wallpapers.name: Dichroic
wallpapers.desc: Tall panes of dichroic glass standing off a sunlit wall: each one shifts colour across its face and throws its complementary light behind it.

wallpapers.name: Chiffon
wallpapers.desc: Two lengths of sheer chiffon drifting across the frame, light passing through every soft fold and the colour deepening where they cross.

wallpapers.name: Plush
wallpapers.desc: Heavy crushed velvet hanging in deep folds: dark where the pile faces you and glowing along every fold as it turns away.

wallpapers.name: Twist
wallpapers.desc: Two wide ribbons twisting through space, turning their bright face and their deep reverse to you in turn, with a highlight at every turn.

wallpapers.name: Soap Film
wallpapers.desc: A soap bubble, thin as air: bands of interference colour swirling at its rim as it drains, and the reflection of an arched window on its face.

wallpapers.name: Stardust
wallpapers.desc: A glowing cloud of gas drifting across deep space, threaded with dark dust lanes, a young star at its bright heart.

wallpapers.name: Horizon
wallpapers.desc: The curve of a planet seen from orbit at sunrise: a thin bright skin of atmosphere along the limb and the sun just breaking over it.

wallpapers.name: Cloud Sea
wallpapers.desc: Above a sea of cloud at sunset: every billow lit gold on the side that faces the low sun and the far banks dissolving into the glow.

wallpapers.name: Aster
wallpapers.desc: A star-shaped flower made only of light: two rings of luminous petals opening from the corner, brightest along their rims and where they overlap.

wallpapers.name: Poppy
wallpapers.desc: A poppy petal seen close up against the sun: thin as silk, glowing from within, crinkled and veined, its ruffled edge lit like a filament.

wallpapers.name: Nautilus
wallpapers.desc: A nautilus shell cut through its heart: chamber after chamber spiralling inward, every wall lined with glowing mother-of-pearl.

wallpapers.name: Pour
wallpapers.desc: An acrylic pour still wet on the panel: ribbons of paint dragged into long swirls, lacy cells blooming in one band and a gloss over all of it.

wallpapers.name: Arcade
wallpapers.desc: A run of painted arches receding into the light, each wall a deeper colour, the sun dropping arch-shaped patches of light onto the next one.

wallpapers.name: Canyon
wallpapers.desc: Looking up through a slot canyon: wind-carved walls folding over one another, glowing where daylight bounces down between them.

wallpapers.name: Ink
wallpapers.desc: Ink poured into still water, unfurling into veils and fine curling threads that glow where you see them edge on.

wallpapers.name: Agate
wallpapers.desc: A polished slice of banded agate held to the light: fine translucent bands of colour following one another around a milky quartz heart.

wallpapers.name: Trails
wallpapers.desc: A long exposure of light swept through the dark: two bundles of fine luminous trails curving past each other, white-hot at the core.

wallpapers.name: Coil
wallpapers.desc: A thick glossy coil spiralling across the frame, each turn passing behind the last, with the studio light gliding along it.

wallpapers.name: Rings
wallpapers.desc: A ringed giant hanging in the dark, its banded clouds lit from one side and its rings sweeping in front, finely divided and shadowed by the planet.

wallpapers.name: Ice Cave
wallpapers.desc: Inside a glacier cave: the ice scalloped by meltwater into shallow cups, glowing blue where daylight soaks through from the mouth of the cave.

wallpapers.name: Meadow
wallpapers.desc: Rolling hills fading into the haze, each slope turned to the low sun and the crests backlit.

wallpapers.name: Barchan
wallpapers.desc: Wind-carved dunes seen from above, warm on every face that catches the low sun and cool in the lee.

wallpapers.name: Frost
wallpapers.desc: Panes of frosted glass floating over soft colour, each blurring what lies beneath and lit along its rim.

wallpapers.name: Cascade
wallpapers.desc: Four soft ribbons of colour sweeping across the frame, each one round in section, lit from above and shading the one below.

wallpapers.name: Folio
wallpapers.desc: Large sheets of coloured paper laid over one another, each edge curling up into a soft roll that casts its shadow on the sheet below.

wallpapers.name: Ripple
wallpapers.desc: A still pond after three drops: rings spreading across the water and bending the colour of the sky in it.

wallpapers.name: Contour
wallpapers.desc: A quiet topographic map: hill-shaded terrain tinted by height, traced with fine contour lines.

wallpapers.name: Watercolor
wallpapers.desc: Loose washes of pigment bleeding into cold-pressed paper, granulating in its tooth and darker where the colour pooled at each edge.

wallpapers.name: Arches
wallpapers.desc: Nested arches in mid-century colour under a low sun, each band raised a little off the one inside it.

wallpapers.name: Strata
wallpapers.desc: Wind-swept sandstone: bands of mineral colour sweeping and folding, polished smooth with a soft relief.

wallpapers.name: Tunnel
wallpapers.desc: Sheets of coloured card cut with soft openings and stood one behind another, like a tunnel book lit from the far end.

wallpapers.name: Celadon
wallpapers.desc: A glazed stoneware bowl seen from above on a linen cloth: the glaze pooling deep in the well, thinning pale on the rim, finely crazed.

wallpapers.name: Harbour
wallpapers.desc: A harbour on still water: by night the quay lights stretch into long trails, by day a row of pastel houses at dawn, both broken into strokes by the slow swell.

wallpapers.name: Oculus
wallpapers.desc: Looking up into a coffered dome: the open eye at its crown full of sky, and the low sun through it laying one bright oval across the coffers.

wallpapers.name: Salt Flat
wallpapers.desc: A salt flat under a skin of rain water, the dusk sky and its clouds doubled in it, the crust showing through in pale ridges at your feet.

wallpapers.name: Dewdrop
wallpapers.desc: A few drops of water resting on coloured card under a soft window light, each one holding a tiny bright window and a pool of light in its shadow.

wallpapers.name: Swell
wallpapers.desc: Open water at the last of the light, seen from just above it: one long glassy swell lifting towards you and the sky laid along its back.

wallpapers.name: Pinewood
wallpapers.desc: Ridges of pine forest stepping back into morning fog, each row of trees paler than the one before, the valleys between them filled with mist.

wallpapers.name: Leaf
wallpapers.desc: A single leaf held up to the light, close enough to see the fine net of its veins glowing through the green.

wallpapers.name: Stairwell
wallpapers.desc: Looking straight up a spiral stair: the white rail winding turn over turn towards the skylight at the top, the plaster paling as it rises.

wallpapers.name: Rows
wallpapers.desc: A field of lavender at the end of the day, its rows running away to a soft horizon and the low light catching the top of every row.

wallpapers.name: Shoji
wallpapers.desc: Paper screens lit from the garden side, their slender wooden lattice crossing the glow and the soft shadow of a maple branch resting on the paper.

wallpapers.name: Iceberg
wallpapers.desc: Icebergs adrift on a glassy polar sea in the long dusk, their faceted sides glowing blue, each one doubled in the still water.

wallpapers.name: Rosette
wallpapers.desc: A succulent seen from straight above: thick spoon-shaped leaves spiralling out from its heart, dusted with a pale bloom and blushing at the tips.

wallpapers.name: Moonrise
wallpapers.desc: A full moon rising over a low far coast at dusk, warmed by the thick air near the horizon, a thin band of cloud drifting across it.

wallpapers.name: Hot Spring
wallpapers.desc: A hot spring seen from the air: a deep blue eye ringed by bands of mineral colour, fine streamers running out over pale crust, a breath of steam.

wallpapers.name: Snowfield
wallpapers.desc: Open snow at the blue hour, smoothed by the wind into long soft drifts, the sky still rose above the far edge and the shadows gone blue.

wallpapers.name: Eclipse
wallpapers.desc: The moment of totality: the moon black against the sun, the pearly corona streaming out round it, and the whole sky gone to twilight.

wallpapers.name: Terrazzo
wallpapers.desc: A polished terrazzo floor in the morning light: a few large chips of coloured marble scattered in a wide pale ground, ground flat and glossed, a window reflected softly across it.

wallpapers.name: Lantern
wallpapers.desc: A paper lantern glowing in a dim room at dusk: fine ribs showing through the paper, the paper folded over a thin wire rim at each end, its warm light on the wall behind.

wallpapers.name: Flax
wallpapers.desc: Plain-woven linen in a soft wash of colour, gently draped, every thread slightly uneven and slubbed, lit by a window you cannot see.

wallpapers.name: Washi
wallpapers.desc: Handmade paper with cloudy pulp, long pale fibres, a few flecks of bark and one soft fold across it.

wallpapers.name: Dawn
wallpapers.desc: The first light over a calm sea: one soft glow on the horizon and its reflection on the water.

wallpapers.name: Arc
wallpapers.desc: Two great arcs and a small sun, tone on tone, each laid on the one beneath with a long soft shadow.

wallpapers.name: Inkwash
wallpapers.desc: Three faint ridges dissolving into morning mist, like an ink painting washed almost to nothing.

wallpapers.name: Pebble
wallpapers.desc: Five river stones on fine sand, seen from above in soft daylight: speckled, veined and resting in their own shadows.

wallpapers.name: Aureole
wallpapers.desc: A soft ring of light whose colour drifts slowly around it, held in a quiet field.

wallpapers.name: Confluence
wallpapers.desc: A gradient mesh of five quiet colours melting into each other under a fine film grain.

wallpapers.name: Afternoon
wallpapers.desc: Late sun through a window falling across a plaster wall, its panes softening and a few leaves in the light.

wallpapers.name: Vellum
wallpapers.desc: Sheets of translucent vellum laid one over another, their long curved edges catching a soft shadow.

wallpapers.name: Plaster
wallpapers.desc: A wall of polished lime plaster under a raking light: broad, overlapping trowel sweeps, each with a soft lip, and a faint cloud in the tone.

wallpapers.name: Felt
wallpapers.desc: A sheet of thick wool felt lying in one soft, deep fold, its dense fibres catching a soft light along the crest.

wallpapers.name: Marble
wallpapers.desc: A honed slab of marble: clouds of mineral colour deep in the stone, one long vein crossing a corner and a few fine threads fading out.

wallpapers.name: Knit
wallpapers.desc: Close on a soft cashmere knit lying in one loose fold: rows of plump stitches, a halo of fine fibre, the window light running along the crest.

wallpapers.name: Zellige
wallpapers.desc: Tall hand-cut zellige tiles in a quiet stack: each glazed face a little uneven and tilted its own way, so a window's soft reflection breaks across them.

wallpapers.name: Nappa
wallpapers.desc: Soft nappa leather with a fine pebbled grain: two gently padded panels meet in one long curved seam, topstitched in a tone of their own.

wallpapers.name: Hammered
wallpapers.desc: A pane of hammered glass in front of a soft evening window: every shallow dimple bends the colour behind it into its own small lens.

wallpapers.name: Fogbow
wallpapers.desc: A fogbow over a still, misty sea: a broad pale arc in the drifting fog, its rim touched warm on the outside and cool within.

wallpapers.name: Duvet
wallpapers.desc: An unmade bed in the first sun: soft cotton thrown into a few broad, rounded folds, the light lying warm along each crest.

wallpapers.name: Gallery
wallpapers.desc: The empty corner of a gallery after hours: two plaster walls washed by soft scallops of light from the ceiling, deepening gently into the corner.

wallpapers.name: Brume
wallpapers.desc: A pale winter sun seen through thick morning fog: a clean soft disc with a wide glow, and slow banks of mist drifting across it.

wallpapers.name: Contrail
wallpapers.desc: A clear evening sky with a single contrail drawn high across it, crisp at its leading end and softening as it drifts, lit by a sun already set.

wallpapers.name: Twilight
wallpapers.desc: Looking away from the sunset over a flat calm sea: the blue shadow of the Earth rising under a soft rose band of light, two threads of high cloud lit in it.

wallpapers.name: Moon Jar
wallpapers.desc: A round porcelain moon jar on a low plinth in soft studio light: a matte milky glaze, a faint seam where its two halves were joined, a long gentle shadow.

wallpapers.name: Pigment
wallpapers.desc: A single heap of pure pigment powder on a seamless studio sweep: perfectly matte, its slopes soft in the key light and a fine dusting spilled around its foot.

wallpapers.name: Lenticular
wallpapers.desc: A lenticular cloud standing still over a far peak at dusk: smooth stacked lenses of vapour, their undersides catching the last warm light.

wallpapers.name: Pillar
wallpapers.desc: A sun pillar over a frozen plain: the sun just gone, a slender column of its light standing up from the horizon through air full of ice.

wallpapers.name: Noctilucent
wallpapers.desc: A summer night that never quite darkens: high, fine ripples of noctilucent cloud glowing pale blue above the last warm band on the horizon.

wallpapers.name: Emboss
wallpapers.desc: Thick cotton rag paper with one large circle blind-embossed into it: no ink, only the raised disc, pressed smooth, its soft shoulder catching a raking light.

wallpapers.name: Concrete
wallpapers.desc: A wall of fair-faced concrete in a raking light: large smooth panels, each a little different in tone and cloud, their fine joints and a few quiet form-tie holes.
